jd.title: Backend Software Engineer - Python/Postgres
jd.summary: Real-world Enveritas backend software engineer posting focused on Python, PostgreSQL, cloud tooling, architecture, and communication.

criteria.label: Python & Web Frameworks
criteria.description: Extensive experience with Python, including developing applications and complex data processing tasks. Familiarity with Django or Flask.

criteria.label: PostgreSQL & Database Tuning
criteria.description: Advanced experience with PostgreSQL, including query optimization, joins, stored procedures, and performance tuning.

criteria.label: Docker, AWS & Linux
criteria.description: Practical experience with Linux, Bash scripting, Docker containers, and AWS services (EC2, RDS, CloudFront).

criteria.label: Professional Backend Experience
criteria.description: Minimum seven years of full-time professional experience as a backend software engineer.

criteria.label: Software Architecture & Design Patterns
criteria.description: Demonstrated ability to apply design patterns for creating modular and efficient software, with the ability to teach others how to solve architectural problems.

criteria.label: Technical Communication
criteria.description: Strong ability to present and explain complex ideas clearly to non-technical colleagues.

criteria.label: Computer Science Education
criteria.description: Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent training in the principles of software engineering.

criteria.label: Progressive HR Experience
criteria.description: 3+ years of progressive HR experience, including supporting multiple business functions and managing a range of HR activities.

criteria.label: Recruitment & Talent Acquisition
criteria.description: Demonstrated experience in recruitment and talent acquisition, partnering with hiring managers and managing multiple open positions.

criteria.label: Employee Relations & Compliance
criteria.description: Strong understanding of HR practices, employee relations, performance management, and applicable employment laws and regulations.

criteria.label: HRIS & MS Office
criteria.description: Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and ability to work effectively with HR information systems and recruiting technology.

criteria.label: Interpersonal & Stakeholder Communication
criteria.description: Strong written, verbal, interpersonal, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to communicate effectively across all levels of an organization. Ability to handle confidential and sensitive matters with discretion, professionalism, and sound judgment.

criteria.label: Education in HR or Business
criteria.description: Bachelor’s degree in human resources, business administration, or a related field.

criteria.label: HR Programs & Initiatives
criteria.description: Experience developing, coordinating, or managing HR programs and initiatives; experience establishing an internship or early-career talent program is preferred.
